architecture: one PciEcam object, two bindings (MmioBinding for ECAM, PortRegionBinding for conf1), shared function table; conf1 adds only the address latch

conf1_ports.0xCF8: address latch, dword read/write, stored mask 0x80FF_FFFC; byte/word write ignored, byte/word read all ones
conf1_ports.0xCF9: reset control not implemented: DeviceError::UnknownOffset on byte read/write; word -> Misaligned
conf1_ports.0xCFA: byte/word write ignored, read all ones (conf2 not implemented)
conf1_ports.0xCFB: byte write ignored, read all ones
conf1_ports.0xCFC-0xCFF: data port, width 1/2/4 aligned, register = (latch & 0xFC) + n; bit31=0, bus>0 or absent function -> all ones, write ignored
